tier: TIER 1 — very fast execution — automation preferred
session: NY session only — 15:30–17:00 Oslo (9:30–11:00 AM ET)
direction: LONG only — buy momentum — never short penny stocks as a beginner
source: Ross Cameron — Warrior Trading — turned $583 into $10M+

what_is_penny_stock.exchange: NYSE and NASDAQ listed ONLY — NO OTC or Pink Sheet stocks — skip ALWAYS
what_is_penny_stock.float: Under 20 million shares is ideal — under 100 million acceptable
what_is_penny_stock.type: Small cap stocks — not large caps like NVDA or TSLA

why_this_works.explanation: Low float + high volume + catalyst = explosive moves
why_this_works.float_turnover: If 10% of float traded pre-market → entire float may trade during the day
why_this_works.potential: These stocks can move 50 to 100% or more in a single day
why_this_works.daily_count: Only 5 to 10 stocks are in play each day out of thousands — scanner finds them

scanner_criteria.3_volume: Relative volume 2x or higher than average — 3x is ideal
scanner_criteria.4_float: Under 100 million shares — under 20 million is high priority
scanner_criteria.5_catalyst: Confirmed news in last 24 hours — earnings, FDA approval, partnership, contract, PR
scanner_criteria.6_exchange: NYSE or NASDAQ only — no OTC or Pink Sheet

warrior_trading.access: BLOCKED by direct fetch (403) — use Apify to scrape
warrior_trading.data: Top 5 most active penny stocks — 15 min delay on free version

earnings_calendar.access: Check every morning for stocks reporting earnings today

entry_rules.entry_1: Buy break of pre-market high — as soon as market opens and stock breaks above pre-market high
entry_rules.entry_2: Opening Range Breakout — buy high of first 1-minute candle after 9:30 AM ET (15:30 Oslo)
entry_rules.entry_3: Red to Green move — stock dips after open then recovers above previous day close
entry_rules.entry_4: First pullback after initial spike — stock surges, pulls back to VWAP or 9 EMA, then bounces
entry_rules.timeout: If stock does not break pre-market high within first 5 minutes = skip — do not chase

exit_rules.sell_half: Sell half position at first profit target — when up 2x the risk amount
exit_rules.move_stop: Move stop to breakeven on remaining position after selling half
exit_rules.sell_remaining: Sell remaining if first 1-minute candle closes red after selling half
exit_rules.max_hold_time: Never hold penny stock momentum trade more than 30 minutes
exit_rules.hard_stop: If stock drops 10% from entry = exit immediately no exceptions

stop_loss_rules.placement: Low of the first 1-minute candle — very tight
stop_loss_rules.risk_limit: Never risk more than 1% of portfolio on a single penny stock trade
stop_loss_rules.wide_stop_fix: If stop is too wide relative to 1% risk → reduce position size — do not widen stop

scoring.description: Add points for each criteria met. Only trade if score is 5 or above.

what_to_avoid: OTC and Pink Sheet stocks — pump and dump risk
Stocks with no confirmed catalyst — gaps without news fade fast
Stocks with float above 100 million shares — too much supply
Stocks that are halted for regulatory reasons — too dangerous
Stocks promoted by newsletters or social media without real catalyst
watchlist_note: This watchlist is DYNAMIC — changes every day based on the scanner. No fixed symbols. Every morning before 15:30 Oslo run the scanner and build a fresh watchlist of 3 to 5 stocks.
